findings.message: PROCESS + deliberate contraction, not a defect: the last five passes' ten findings (four credential-exposing) were all in the rendered command line, and two of those were introduced by fixes for the previous one, so the visibility now keeps a count and the PROGRAM names and stores no command text at all. REQ-1/AC-1 are amended accordingly and the reason is recorded here and in docs/security.md. Re-sealing.
